title: Get Ask AI to write an email or post
blurb: Draft emails, texts and social posts in seconds, then tweak them.

steps.title: Open Ask AI
steps.body: Click **Ask AI** in the left menu.

steps.title: Give it a short brief
steps.body: Tell it who it's for, what you're offering and the tone. For example: "Write a Facebook post for our winter heat pump service special. Friendly, short, NZ audience."

steps.title: Ask for changes
steps.body: Reply with tweaks like "shorter", "less salesy" or "add a call to book online". Keep going until you're happy.

steps.title: Use the result
steps.body: Copy the text into your email, campaign or Social Planner post. You can also ask it to create an image to go with it.
